name: sort-indicator
title: Sort Indicator
description: Sortable header plus a readback that states the sort in plain words ("Sorted by Due date, oldest first"), warns when the order comes from a hidden column, empty values or pinned rows, and animates rows to their new place so a re-sort can be followed.

meta.summary: States a table's sort in plain words and warns when hidden columns, empty values or pinned rows make the order look wrong.
catches: Sort by a column that isn't on screen, with a reveal action
Empty values, kept last in both directions and counted
Pinned rows that stay first regardless of sort
Direction in words that fit the column (A to Z, oldest first)
limits: Sorting helper uses natural numeric comparison; locale-specific collation may differ
You place aria-sort on your <th> (ariaSort helper provided)
a11y: Header button with a descriptive title; use the ariaSort helper for aria-sort on <th>
Sort readback and warnings render in polite live regions
Row animation (FLIP) is skipped under reduced motion
Reverse and clear are labelled buttons
